subject: Cool man
author: SUFFUR
body:
Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when it's going to run out? And a web site being down does not bother me one bit, it just threw me for a few seconds, ok maybe a few more, but i just heard a good story and I was still with that when I refreshed, I was wondering when I traveled 88 mph to go back that was all?

No speedo on me at the time, but I just guessed, that i did no more than 1 mph, but then the world is moving about 1000 mph, then the wind is blowing, another 2 mph and I may have farted too, so add some propulsion into the equation, a 1/2 mhp, had beans, the blood rushing around my body carried some momentum, to add to that, say another 1/2 a mph, the plates of the earth are moving, some 1/2 mph per thousand years or so, unless mother earth is upset, then a lot faster, (an unknown figure, of this authour, at the time, but we will call '0' as in "'0' tihs si dekcuf pu!") plus the space's I am in, are moving, and at diffirent times too, from other space's in the space time chain of event's thingy ma'-bob (Kevlar-0-sore-ass, an Edition, still to be written by the Great Philosopher, Toga wearing, Kamping, LUCANOX), may his words spead wisdom to all), and with gravity pushing me around too, I may have hit 88 mph? Six Probuscuss? How long to work that one out, I say, drunk first! LucanDX next, or maybe that number should be tapped into a cactus of what happened  tommorrow  the day before yesterday or not?

I was going to get Bill to sort out a computer to put in the numbers, but he is busy, watching the progess of Live, so has no time for my lost time. So I'm buggered to what happened, that in truth, never happen, as the servers of the site glitched for me. So I now, feel better about this, I think?

Good day to you all, and a smile goes a long way, and more energy efficiant, ...so frowning means you burn more calories? Arh now I get it, so much is explained,... understood, ...why people are so miserable, they are just doing their exercises, when they see me, and so was I. But when I'm not exercising, I smile and people smile back, even for just a second, it's all cool.
